name: Bonza vegan kibble
note: Bonza vegan kibble, from bonza.dog product page (as fed): protein 25%, fat 12.5%, fibre 4.5%, ash 7.5%, moisture 9%, Ca 0.9%, P 0.7%, DHA 0.22% + EPA 0.005%, 3581 kcal/kg. Vitamins/choline = ADDED amounts per kg (ingredients add more). Na, K, Mg not declared. Also adds taurine 1500 mg/kg, L-carnitine, DL-methionine 5000 mg/kg (urine-acidifying), Zn, Fe, Cu, Mn, I, Se. Bonza's help-centre lists slightly different older figures (protein 25.2%, P 0.87%, 345 kcal/100 g) - check your bag.
